hero.heading: Lead Us From Illusion To Truth, From Darkness To Light, From Transience To Lasting Impact

rows.title: Our Inspiration
rows.body: Inspired By The Timeless Wisdom Of The Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upanishad, Our Ethos Is Rooted In A Vedic Prayer That Guides Us From Illusion To Truth, Darkness To Light, And Transience To Lasting Impact. This Philosophy Drives Our Commitment To Meaningful Change In Conscious Commerce.

rows.title: Who We Are
rows.body: 79° East Is A Premier Platform Connecting Conscious Brands With Sustainable, Ethical Manufacturers. We Simplify Value-Aligned Sourcing, Ensuring Transparency And Impact, Empowering Brands To Produce Responsibly And Lead With Purpose.

rows.title: Our Mission
rows.body: We Strive To Unite Conscious Businesses With Trusted Manufacturers Dedicated To Sustainability, Ethical Sourcing, And Innovation. By Leveraging Renewable Energy, Creating Eco-Friendly Products, And Pursuing Zero-Waste Systems, We Empower Communities And Drive A Global Shift Toward Responsible Commerce.
